He opens his eyes again.

Soon, everyone starts to clap.
He raises his hand high.
The crowd cheers loudly.
He steps to the left side.
He points to a young boy.
The boy waves back excitedly.
The man laughs at the gesture.
He continues his energetic dance.
His shoes tap on the wood.
Sweat beads on his forehead.
He wipes it away quickly.

He hits a high note.
The crowd gasps in awe.

He speaks about his journey.

The crowd listens intently.
He shares a funny story.

He feels grateful for this.

The crowd jumps with him.
Energy fills the entire space.
He runs across the stage.
He grabs a second mic.
He sings with more power.
The lights flash red and blue.
Smoke rises from the floor.
He feels alive in this moment.
He knows this is magic.
The song ends abruptly.
He stands still and breathes.
The crowd roars again.
He waves to the back.
He waves to the sides.
He feels a deep connection.
He knows they love him.
He takes one last bow.
The lights fade to black.
The show is finally over.
He walks off the stage.
His heart beats fast.
He feels completely happy.
The night was perfect.
He will do it again.
Tomorrow brings a new crowd.
But tonight was special.
He remembers every face.
He remembers every cheer.
He remembers the song.
He remembers the feeling.
It was a great night.
